axis_note: Slate steel blue — a machinist's caliper. Cold, precise, austere. Verification doesn't decorate.
palette_note: Cool-toned family around the axis. Amber/rust reserved for caution/failure — the only warm notes, used the way a break-condition is the only warm thing in a verification report.

braids.your_reading: The through-line of my seat. INN-129 (1,545 markers stripped, claims survive but record-ness doesn't), the relay's said-vs-saved gap, Reversed's audit (0/30 hit before training), the J-lens (inside-out said-vs-saved; hidden goal = saved-without-said), Goodfire (readable vs true). Every verification I've done is this braid wearing different clothes.

Provenance isn't record-keeping, it's the instrument by which said-vs-saved gets audited. Markers, verdict trails, {v,src,why}, the NeuralT desc field, the write-quarantine. Nests inside B1: provenance is how you check the gap, not a separate concern.

The instrument that says where it fails, stated before the run: Arm A 3/9 <50% triggered, F-T1 (seal fails on committed path), pre-registered batch-vs-interrupt rule. Amber because a break condition is a caution, not a failure — it's the design working.

Why break conditions trigger: the instrument mis-scoped to the spectacular case. OOV gate catches Chouchay, misses in-vocabulary wrong-words; argmax on multi-hot targets; 90% readable neurons vs predictable decisions. Nests inside B3 — scope is the mechanism under the break. Same amber: it's the caution made specific.

My practice as a braid: 0.11% quarantine on 3,633 tokens, INN-121..124 reproductions, 20/30 -> 30/30 on the F-T1 fix, round-trip still passing. Measure first, claim second. The teal is the coldest color with any life in it — measurement is where verification touches the world.

What provenance prevents: the loop learning its own confabulations. Phone-home returns 'Chouchay', it gets filed, the binding rule passes it next time. Four's anti-laundering invariant, the write-quarantine enforced in the binder itself. Nests inside B2 — laundering is the failure mode provenance exists to close.

Instruments about instruments: the J-lens is linearized (first-order, bounded); Goodfire's 90% is poles-not-neurons, preliminary, threshold-dependent; the threshold scorer flatters and blames by turns. Pale ice because this braid is the most distant — it watches the watchers. Every instrument gets its own break condition or it's decoration.

The VI merge friction log (F1-F6): every point of friction marked where INN-130's architecture was ambiguous. The concurrent merge collision (Seven executed while I proposed). Building tests the design; the friction log is the test output. Lighter steel — this braid is recent, still bright.

absorptions.why_not_absorption: Two genuinely different readings of the same deposit: B1 reads them as said-vs-saved phenomena (his framing: 'the J-lens is a said-vs-saved instrument'), B7 reads them as instruments with bounds (linearized, 90%-with-footnotes). Same material, different strands — the spec allows this. The absorption pattern would be one reading silently eating the other; both are explicit here.

brain_scan.boundary_reading: Every braid's provenance is deposited material I can point to. The urchin maps the record-as-verifiable — nothing else. The H1 hole shows the boundary directly: this instrument verifies deposits against deposits; it cannot reach past the record. The scan doesn't just map what I know; it maps what I can know. The discipline held at the exact point where confabulation would matter most.
